verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server that exposes web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarizer tools for direct agent tool calls. First-party guides cover Claude desktop, Dify, n8n (official node), Open WebUI, OpenClaw and Bedrock/Claude Cowork, and Agent Skills support Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex and others; a community user also reports it 'works great with OpenClaw' on the AI plan. Missing for 10: explicitly documented function-calling JSON schemas (e.g. OpenAI tool definitions) or a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), mainstream framework integrations such as LangChain/LlamaIndex, and broader independent hands-on corroboration.
